description: This file contains the implementation of the AccountAssociationsReadPlatformService interface for the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to retrieve account association data from a database, particularly handling links between loan and savings accounts, and determining if an account is linked with active accounts.

classes.name: AccountAssociationsReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service to read account associations, utilizing JdbcTemplate for database operations, handling retrieval and status checks of linked accounts.

classes.name: AccountAssociationsMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL query results to AccountAssociationsData objects.

methods.name: retriveLoanLinkedAssociation
methods.description: Retrieves linked loan account data associated with a given loan ID.

methods.name: retriveLoanAssociations
methods.description: Fetches all loan associations for a given loan ID and association type.

methods.name: retriveSavingsLinkedAssociation
methods.description: Retrieves linked savings account data for a specified savings account ID.

methods.name: isLinkedWithAnyActiveAccount
methods.description: Checks if a savings account is linked with any active account, considering loan and savings account statuses.

methods.name: retriveSavingsAccount
methods.description: Fetches savings account details for a given savings ID.
